text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Angola's largest independent trade union, CGSILA, called off a strike on Friday, which started on March 20, over the government's failure to pay wages.
- Government and UNITA representatives have concluded discussions on a programme for Angola's unity government, one of UNITA's demands ahead of the swearing in of the new government.
